title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Silver Legacy, Reno | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Silver Legacy Resort & Casino in Reno, Nevada, USA, on 20 March 1999.

It was the 25th show by the fifth All-Starr Band, and the second of two consecutive nights in Reno. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr returned to the Silver Legacy on 25 July 2008.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

Concert setlist

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Whisky Train’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Sunshine Of Your Love’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘Love Me Do’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘No No Song’
  • ‘All Right Now’ (Simon Kirke)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘Bang The Drum All Day’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘White Room’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘A Whiter Shade Of Pale’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
